userStories.title: tree.py — CMP Thompson sampling + expansion rule + get_best_agent
userStories.description: Add to EvolutionTree (created in US-206): (1) get_descendant_evals(node_id, num_pseudo=10) — NOTE: num_pseudo=10 from HGM source code (NOT 100). Recursively collect descendant utility_measures. For each node: if node has fewer evals than num_pseudo AND has >=1 eval, use [mean_utility]*num_pseudo as the node's contribution (pseudo-counts from HGM CMP). If node has >= num_pseudo evals, use raw utility_measures. If node has 0 evals, contribute empty list. Then recurse into all children and extend. This is HGM's Clade-Metaproductivity (CMP) estimator. (2) thompson_sample(for_expansion=True) — compute tau=self.eval_budget/max(1, self.eval_budget - self.n_evals). For each node: if for_expansion, evals=get_descendant_evals(node_id); else evals=list(node.utility_measures). Compute successes=sum(evals), failures=len(evals)-successes. alpha=tau*(1+successes), beta_param=tau*(1+failures). Sample theta from numpy.random.beta(max(alpha,0.01), max(beta_param,0.01)). Return node_id with highest theta. (3) should_expand(alpha=0.6) — return self.n_evals**alpha >= len(self.nodes)-1 (exclude root from count). (4) get_best_agent() — return node with highest mean_utility among nodes with >=3 evaluations. If none qualify, return root node. Must import numpy.

Always increment mutations_attempted. (c) else (measure): node_id=tree.thompson_sample(for_expansion=False), task=tree.select_unevaluated_task(node_id), if None continue. Call eval_agent_code_docker(node.code, task, project_root), tree.record_eval(node_id, task_id, result.passed), update archive. (d) Every 20 evals: check plateau, if detected increment plateaus_detected. (e) Save tree.save_state('results/evolution_state.json'). Log progress. (3) Build EvolutionReport from final state.
